name: v1.1.3
body:
# Changelog for `poutine` v1.1.3 🎉

This release focuses on **core engine improvements**, **stability fixes**, and **modernization of the toolchain**. The biggest shift is the move away from exec-based Git operations toward a fully in-memory model using `go-git`, along with improved resiliency and observability during analysis.

---

## Major Improvements 🌟🌟

* ⚡ **In-Memory Git with `go-git` v6**: Replaced exec-based Git operations with `go-git` using in-memory storage. This significantly improves performance, portability, and reduces reliance on system binaries, by @SUSTAPLE117.  
  ([#400](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/400))

* 🛡️ **Resilient Repository Batch Fetching**: Improved robustness of repository batch fetching, reducing failures during large-scale analysis operations, by @SUSTAPLE117.  
  ([#399](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/399))

* 📊 **Analysis Progress Monitoring Improvements**: Enhanced visibility into analysis progress, making long-running operations easier to track and debug, by @SUSTAPLE117.  
  ([#419](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/419))

---

## Improvements 🔧

* 🧪 **Snapshot Testing Added**: Introduced snapshot testing to improve regression detection and testing confidence, by @SUSTAPLE117.  
  ([#401](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/401))

* ⚙️ **Go 1.26 Upgrade + Dependency Refresh**: Upgraded to **Go 1.26** and refreshed dependencies for improved performance and compatibility, by @SUSTAPLE117.  
  ([#412](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/412))

* 🔐 **Improved Rule Handling for GitHub Actions**: Configured `skip` actions to be ignored for the `github_action_from_unverified_creator_used` rule, improving rule accuracy, by @mbarbero.  
  ([#398](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/398))

* 📦 **Goreleaser Configuration Updates**: Updated release configuration and tooling for improved build and distribution workflows, by @SUSTAPLE117.  
  ([#417](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/417)), ([#418](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/418))

---

## Bug Fixes 🐛

* 🐳 **Docker Image Parsing Fixes**: Fixed issues with Docker image parsing and purl generation, by @SUSTAPLE117.  
  ([#413](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/413))

* 📄 **YAML Parsing Fixes**: Resolved YAML parsing errors affecting analysis reliability, by @SUSTAPLE117.  
  ([#414](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/414))

* 🔑 **GitHub Fine-Grained PAT Compatibility**: Fixed organization repository listing failures when using fine-grained tokens without `Issues:Read`, by @fproulx-boostsecurity.  
  ([#415](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/415))

* 🧾 **SARIF Taxonomy GUID Fix**: Corrected SARIF taxonomy GUID issues to ensure proper report compatibility, by @SUSTAPLE117.  
  ([#416](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/416))

---

## Dependency Updates ⬆️

### GitHub Actions

* Updated `github/codeql-action` from `3.30.5` to `4.31.2`. ([#370](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/370))
* Updated `ossf/scorecard-action` from `2.4.2` to `2.4.3`. ([#371](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/371))
* Updated `step-security/harden-runner` from `2.13.0` to `2.13.1`. ([#375](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/375))
* Updated `actions/upload-artifact` from `4.6.2` to `5.0.0`. ([#376](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/376))
* Updated `actions/setup-go` from `5.5.0` to `6.4.0`. ([#403](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/403))
* Updated `goreleaser/goreleaser-action` from `6.4.0` to `7.0.0`. ([#411](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/411))
* Updated `actions/deploy-pages` from `4.0.5` to `5.0.0`. ([#410](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/410))
* Updated `actions/checkout` from `5.0.0` to `6.0.2`. ([#408](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/408))
* Updated `sigstore/cosign-installer` across versions `3.9.2 → 4.0.0 → 4.1.1`. ([#377](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/377)), ([#405](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/405))

### Go Modules

* Updated `gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go` from `0.151.0` to `0.157.1`. ([#369](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/369))
* Updated `github.com/open-policy-agent/opa` from `1.9.0` to `1.10.0`. ([#372](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/372))
* Updated `github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go` from `0.41.1` to `0.42.0`. ([#373](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/373))
* Updated `golang.org/x/oauth2` from `0.31.0` to `0.32.0`. ([#374](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/374))
* Updated `golang.org/x/crypto` from `0.42.0` to `0.45.0`. ([#380](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/380))

# Changelog for `poutine` v1.0.1 🎉

We’re thrilled to announce the release of **`poutine` v1.0.1** — marking a major milestone in the project’s evolution! This version introduces powerful new MCP capabilities, enhanced developer experience, and several dependency updates to keep everything running smoothly.

## Major New Features 🌟🌟

* 🧠 **Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration**: Introduced full MCP support, including a new **Poutine MCP Server**, **local analysis capabilities**, and **comprehensive setup instructions**. This integration enables seamless interoperability with external tools and automation workflows. Implemented by @SUSTAPLE117.

  * [[#346 – Add Poutine MCP Server](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/346)](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/346)

body:
# Changelog for `poutine` v0.18.0 🎉

We're delighted to roll out `poutine` v0.18.0! This release is packed adds some cool new rule and small enhancements.

## Major New Rule 🌟🌟

-   🛡️ **New Confused Deputy Auto-Merge Rule**: Introduced a new security rule to detect potential Confused Deputy vulnerabilities related to auto-merge workflows, contributed by @fproulx-boostsecurity. ([#304](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/304))
  - Checkout the [rule's documentation](https://boostsecurityio.github.io/poutine/rules/confused_deputy_auto_merge/)
  - And [read the blog article](https://boostsecurity.io/blog/weaponizing-dependabot-pwn-request-at-its-finesticd-with-style-lotp-guide) to learn more about this vulnerability class.

## Improvements 🔧

-   ✨ **CLI and Config File `include` Option**: You can now specify an `include` option in both the CLI and configuration file for more granular control over scanned paths, introduced by @Talgarr. ([#289](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/289))
-   🏃 **Support for Large Ubuntu and Windows Runners**: Added capability to utilize larger GitHub-hosted runners for Ubuntu and Windows, enhancing CI flexibility, by @Talgarr. ([#293](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/293))
-   ⚙️ **GitHub Actions Strategy Matrix Parsing**: Enhanced parsing capabilities for GitHub Actions strategy matrices, implemented by @SUSTAPLE117. This PR also includes various dependency updates. ([#301](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/301))
-   🛠️ **Core Refactoring**: Significant refactoring of internal components for improved maintainability and performance, by @Talgarr. ([#291](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/291))
-   🧩 **Enhanced Extensibility**: Exported additional fields to simplify the development of extensions and integrations with `poutine`, thanks to @Talgarr. ([#292](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/292))
-   📢 **Clearer Git Ref Error Reporting**: Implemented more specific error messages when a Git reference is unreachable, improving debuggability, by @SUSTAPLE117. ([#302](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/302))
-   📝 **README Typo Correction**: Fixed a typo in the README documentation (`--scm-base-uri` to `--scm-base-url`), thanks to @natcl. ([#303](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/303))

## Dependency Updates ⬆️

### GitHub Actions

-   Updated `actions/dependency-review-action` from `4.5.0` to `4.6.0`. ([#294](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/294))
-   Updated `sigstore/cosign-installer` from `3.7.0` to `3.8.2`. ([#295](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/295))
-   Updated `actions/upload-artifact` from `4.6.0` to `4.6.2`. ([#296](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/296))
-   Updated `actions/setup-go` from `5.3.0` to `5.4.0`. ([#297](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/297))
-   Updated `github/codeql-action` from `3.28.13` to `3.28.16`. ([#298](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/298))

## New Contributors 👋

-   Welcome @natcl, who made their first contribution by fixing a typo in our README ([#303](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/303))! We appreciate your attention to detail!

## Full Changelog 📜

For a detailed view of all changes, see the [full changelog](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/compare/v0.17.0...v0.18.0).

name: v0.17.0
body:
# Changelog for `poutine` v0.17.0 🎉🎂

Happy 1st Anniversary to `poutine`! We're thrilled to mark this milestone with a significant release packed with new capabilities and improvements.

## New Features 🌟

-   **🚀 Groundbreaking Stale Branch Analysis**: Introduced by @Talgarr, newest full time member of our Security Research team, this highly efficient stale branches scanner helps uncover potentially exploitable `pull_request_target` vulnerabilities lurking in forgotten branches, even if they've been patched in the default branch. ([#285](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/285))
-   **Enhanced LOTP Analysis**: Added support for many more Living Off The Pipeline (LOTP) tools, contributed by @Talgarr. ([#286](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/286))

## Improvements 🔧

-   **Optimized Skip Rule Logic**: Refined the logic for skipping rules during analysis for better performance and accuracy. ([#287](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/287))
-   **Linter Migration**: Completed migration to a new linter setup as part of ongoing code quality efforts. ([#284](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/284))

## Dependency Updates ⬆️

### GitHub Actions

-   Updated `ossf/scorecard-action` from `v2.4.0` to `v2.4.1`. ([#268](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/268))
-   Updated `step-security/harden-runner` from `v2.10.4` to `v2.11.0`. ([#270](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/270))

-   Updated `goreleaser/goreleaser-action` from `v6.1.0` to `v6.3.0`. ([#282](https://github.com/boostsecurityio/poutine/pull/282))

### Go Libraries
